project.description: Renders the gateway/operations/query env files for a stack and uploads to S3. Always renders all three together (shared tokens are minted per run). Re-running rotates QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN / PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN / AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT — always redeploy the three services afterwards.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git hash of the infrastructure repo to checkout

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
assume_role
# Get logging API key from logging.env in S3 (same derivation as Teardown and Rebuild) logging_api_key=$( aws s3 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env" /tmp/logging.env >/dev/null && grep -oP '^LOGGING_API_KEY=\K.*' /tmp/logging.env ) rm -f /tmp/logging.env 2>/dev/null || true logging_api_key="${logging_api_key:-disabled}"
cd app-infrastructure/template-renderer
terraform init -input=false
# All three env files render together: the shared tokens are minted per apply # and must stay identical across gateway.env, operations.env, and query.env. terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false \ -var="stack_s3_bucket=${stack_s3_bucket}" \ -var="environment_name=${environment_name}" \ -var="target_stack=${TARGET_STACK}" \ -var="env_private_dns_name=${env_private_dns_name}" \ -var="render_auth_hpds=false" \ -var="render_open_hpds=false" \ -var="render_visualization=false" \ -var="render_picsure_services=true" \ -var="picsure_token_introspection_token=${picsure_token_introspection_token}" \ -var="logging_api_key=${logging_api_key}" \ -var="app_user_secret_name=${database_app_user_secret_name}" \ -var="include_open_hpds=${include_open_hpds}"
reset_role
